title: Skin Runtime Registry, Selection Resolver & Legacy Adapter Foundation
objective: Implement the first production UISK runtime seam: registry-backed Skin Pack identities and availability, exact alias resolution, deterministic assignment precedence, safe apply/clear helpers, and Ember/Chromatic compatibility without implementing later material/frame/effect engines or production target-skin assets.

included: canonical registry identities for Ember/Chromatic plus the eighteen target Skin Packs
runtime availability metadata distinguishing live migration packs from design-complete not-yet-implemented packs
exact alias resolution including talker-theme to roses-theme
follow-context versus always-use-personal assignment precedence resolver
safe presentation-only apply and clear helpers
excluded: new production Skin Pack visual assets
gameplay, permission, hidden-information, routing, validation or provenance authority changes
MCS implementation or MCS checkpoint changes
scope.completion_gate: The shared UI package exposes a registry-backed Skin Pack runtime foundation with deterministic selection/fallback semantics and legacy Ember/Chromatic compatibility; exact-head validation passes; publication is durable; UISR-01 closes to UISR-02 without modifying the product-development lane.

selection_boundaries: Owner explicitly created a parallel ui-implementation lane so UISR and MCS can run concurrently.
UISR-01 is presentation infrastructure only and creates no gameplay, permission, hidden-information, campaign, world, rules, validation or provenance authority.
Only Ember and Chromatic are activatable in UISR-01; the eighteen target packs may be registered as known design identities but remain unavailable until their implementation tranches.
Roses Theme is canonical; talker-theme is an exact compatibility alias only.
MCS/product-development state is out of UISR scope except same-repository publication evidence.
next_action: UISR-02 is selected_not_started in the ui-implementation lane. Await the next owner Continue before govern-starting it. Do not modify product-development/MCS state.
